cdp_rules.block_mean_days: base (T1/T2 5, T3 28) x block_factor of the final step
cdp_rules.exclusions: every stress cell failing null control at the final step, listed verbatim; failing non-stress cells are also listed (they imply DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY via ladder FAIL)
cdp_rules.ladder_step: smallest k in {0,1,2} at which every non-stress null cell of the task (incl. T2 verification cells) has fp_k/n <= 5/100 (exact) AND Wilson-95 UB <= 0.07 (tie |UB-0.07| <= 1e-12 fails); none -> FAIL -> task DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; every step needed must be present for every cell, else UNRESOLVED_LADDER
cdp_rules.n_star_T1_T2: upward-closed: the smallest grid positive count c (non-stress, non-verification cells) such that EVERY such cell with positives >= c has power pass_k/n >= 80/100 at BSS_min (0.02); none -> T1 INSUFFICIENT_ALWAYS / T2 DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY
cdp_rules.t2_breakout_count_threshold: ceil(n*_T2 x 10 / 3) in exact integers; B2 verification: every non-stress T2 cell (incl. pi=0.2) with n_events >= threshold must pass power, else STOP; no such cell -> DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY (THRESHOLD_BEYOND_GRID)
cdp_rules.t3: reference cells persistence 0.95 (both shapes): power < 50 % -> DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; else every non-stress cell power >= 80 % -> n*_T3 = 517 days; else INSUFFICIENT_ALWAYS
cdp_rules.trip_wire_ceiling: max max_bss over all skill levels and non-stress cells of the task

fixture_tests: p2_research/tests/test_mi_phase1.py: pass, ladder step 1, step 2, FAIL, infeasible n*, every STOP precondition, B2 check both ways, ties
numerics: rational gates in exact integers; Wilson in IEEE-754 double, z = 1.959963984540054; ties toward the conservative side
